script.cite: BK2 printed p.9 step 1 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.15
script.quote: Turn power ON. Move slide switch to the left. Light 1 comes ON to indicate that a "one" (binary data) is being stored in SECONDARY STORAGE, Section 1.

script.cite: BK2 printed p.9 step 2 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.15
script.quote: Move slide switch 1 to the right. Light 1 goes OFF to indicate that a "zero" (binary data) is now being stored in SECONDARY STORAGE, Section 1.
